name: Power over Poison
summary: In Darnassus, a young druid returns to complete Power over Poison. The Cenarion Circle's trial began in Darkshore, where the initiate learned to brew a remedy by hand.

sections.title: The Student's Humility
sections.body: In Darkshore, Alanndarian Nightsong asks young druids to gather Earthroot and Lunar Fungus by hand. They brew a salve to heal stricken wildlife. Before granting the magic to purge toxins, the Cenarion Circle wants initiates to know the hardship of treating poison without spiritual aid. The work teaches them what common folk face when venom strikes, and why a druid must meet their suffering with care.

sections.title: Return to the Enclave
sections.body: After the remedy proves effective in Auberdine, Starblaze sends the druid across the sea to Darnassus. Mathrengyl Bearwalker awaits in the Cenarion Enclave. Pleased with the initiate's grace under pressure, he teaches the art of cleansing toxins through nature's power. But virulent poisons in the wilds around Auberdine trouble him, for they point to an unnatural blight disturbing the land's balance.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The trial teaches a druid to cure poison with magic after first preparing a salve by hand. The student returns from Darkshore to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus to learn Cure Poison.

Dendrite Starblaze is an elder druid at Nighthaven in Moonglade. He guides initiates through spiritual trials, testing their patience and dedication to nature before sending them to their home trainers.

Mathrengyl Bearwalker is a master druid trainer in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. He trains night elf druids in forms, restorative arts, and the duties of the Cenarion Circle beneath Teldrassil's boughs.

faq.q: Why was the druid required to make a cure by hand first?
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze teaches that druids should understand poison's physical toll and the work of treating it without magic. Gathering ordinary ingredients and tending the sick by hand teaches humility and appreciation for the natural gifts they are about to receive.

faq.q: What concerns Mathrengyl about the situation in Auberdine?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl finds the lethal toxins in the Darkshore wilds around Auberdine unnatural. Their effect on native wildlife and plants threatens the land's balance and suggests a corrupting influence along the coast.

angles.text: As a druid, you begin with humble herbal work before receiving nature's magic to cleanse venom.
As a night elf, you undertake this trial in Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave, where it reflects Kaldorei reverence for balance and stewardship of their ancient forests.
